articles.summary: KING OF PRUSSIA, Pa. , Dec. 10, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Health Realty Income Trust (NYSE: UHT) announced today that its Board of Trustees voted to increase the quarterly dividend by $.005 and pay a dividend of $.745 per share on December 31, 2025 to shareholders of record as of December 22,
